description: Involute spur gear, ISO 53 basic rack at 20° pressure angle with ISO 54 preferred modules: a toothed disc (dp = m*z, da = m*(z+2), df = m*(z-2.5)) with the body style set by the tooth count — catalog Style A (one-sided hub boss) up to z = 30 and Style B (plain disc) from z = 32 — a center bore, and a DIN 6885A keyway on the hard-tier hub gears. Reuses geomlib.involute_gear_profile.
source: norelem 22400 datasheet (spur gears in steel, milled straight teeth, engagement angle 20°) for the module series + pressure angle + Style A/B (z <= 30 vs z >= 32); ISO 53 involute profile + ISO 54 module series as the profile convention; DIN 6885-1 Form A key seats. z = 12 is the catalog minimum (low-z profiles bridge the root, an approximation — see NOTES.md).
